summary_en: 574,200 shares (5.0% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥996/share ceiling (¥571.9M upper limit). Single-block trade on 2026-08-13 at Tokyo Stock Exchange. Stated rationale: employee and officer incentive-plan funding and liquidity improvement. Sony Semiconductor Solutions (major shareholder) intends to sell portion of MEEQ stake.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares via off-market purchases (ToSTNeT-3) and anticipated changes in major shareholders
translation_en_brief: MEEQ Inc. announced on 2026-08-12 that its board has authorized the acquisition of up to 574,200 treasury shares (5.0% of shares outstanding excluding treasury, or 11.48M shares as of end-March 2026) via a single off-market block trade on the Tokyo Stock Exchange using ToSTNeT-3. The acquisition price is capped at ¥996 per share (the close on 2026-08-12), with a maximum outlay of ¥571.9M. The buy order will be placed on 2026-08-13 at 08:45 JST and is valid only for that trading window; results will be announced after close. The company stated two rationales: funding employee and officer incentive plans, and improving liquidity in its shares. In a related matter, Sony Semiconductor Solutions, a major shareholder, has notified MEEQ of its intention to sell a portion of its stake, which may trigger a change in the major-shareholder roster.
